tools.name: qie_get_balances
tools.description: Read the native QIE balance and known token balances for an address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983). Pass a checksummed or all-lowercase hex address. A QIE ID such as yourname.qie is accepted on mainnet and is resolved the same way as qie_resolve_name; if it does not resolve, the status is unresolved and no balance is invented. Amounts are raw integers plus a decimal formatting of those integers. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

address.description: A 20-byte hex address, or a QIE ID such as yourname.qie (mainnet).

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

include_tokens.description: When true, include token balances reported by the network explorer. Defaults to true.

tools.name: qie_resolve_name
tools.description: Resolve a QIE ID such as yourname.qie to its QIE address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990). A bare label gets .qie appended. The server reads the QIE ID record stores (free QIE IDs first, then paid) whose source is published on the QIE explorer, and checks that each upgradeable proxy still points at the reviewed implementation. A name with no record returns status ok with address null. The address always comes from the chain. When the server has the QIE ID API configured, the result can also include otherChainAddresses (bitcoin, solana, tron, xrp records), each one only if the record store holds the same value on chain. QIE ID is not deployed on testnet (chain 1983), so lookups there return status unresolved. No address is guessed. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

tools.name: qie_reverse_lookup
tools.description: Look up the QIE ID, such as yourname.qie, for an address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990): the default QIE ID the owner chose, otherwise the free QIE ID the address holds. When the chain gives no name and the server has the QIE ID API configured, the names the API lists for the address are tried, free QIE IDs first. A name is shown only when it resolves back to the same address through a QIE ID record store published on the QIE explorer. An address with no QIE ID returns status ok with name null. QIE ID is not deployed on testnet (chain 1983), so lookups there return status unresolved. No name is guessed. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

tools.name: qie_get_tx_status
tools.description: Read whether a transaction is pending, successful, failed, or not found on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983). The result includes the block number, confirmations, from, to, value, token transfers when the explorer reports them, and an explorer link. Example QIE ID: yourname.qie. This does not submit a transaction. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

txHash.description: Transaction hash: 0x followed by 64 hex characters.

tools.name: qie_list_tokens
tools.description: List tokens on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983). Official tokens come from the curated list and are marked source config, official, and verified, with chain name and chainId on every curated row. Explorer tokens may follow and are not official. The same address is official WETH on QIE and official WQIE on Ethereum; results are keyed by chainId and address, and that collision is noted on the token. A known unofficial Wrapped QIE and a known unofficial WETH on QIE are marked not official and not verified. An optional query matches symbol or name. yourname.qie is a QIE ID example, not a token query. Results are capped at 50 and do not include prices. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

query.description: Optional symbol or name fragment. Not a price or yield question.

limit.description: Maximum tokens to return. Default 20, maximum 50.

tools.name: qie_get_network_info
tools.description: Return the pinned facts for QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983): chain ID, name, RPC URLs, explorer URL, and native currency. Example QIE ID: yourname.qie. The caller cannot supply an RPC URL or chain ID. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.
